title: Seagrove Beach "Salt & Sol" 121 Dalton Drive
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS:- 6- Passenger Low-Speed Vehicle - Private pool *Pool heating is available from October 1st through May 1st for an additional fee of $45 per day.- Firepit and outdoor grill area- 4 adult bikes- Ping Pong- Complete Clean Linen Participant - All linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkoutDETAILS: Welcome to Salt & Sol, a Seagrove Beach home with 3 bedrooms and 3.5 bathrooms that sleeps up to 10 guests. Brimming with natural beauty and off-beach activities, enjoy the laid-back ambience of this coastal community. With a screened-in porch, private pool, and a quick walk to the beach, guests will find everything they need for a classic Florida vacation!Hardwood floors stretch throughout this charming home as guests enter and head down the hall to the great room. Cook without missing out on the group fun in the open kitchen, featuring a gas-stove and center island. Relax on the 2 cozy couches in the living area and stream family-favorites on the 65” Smart TV. With 5 chairs and a bench, there’s seating for 8 at the dining table. Outside, discover a private oasis—complete with a crystal-clear pool with a sun shelf and chaise lounges. The built-in natural gas grill and outdoor dining set for 8 call for an epic barbecue. After eating under the stars, gather around the firepit to continue making memories into the night or settle into the furnished screened-in porch. When it’s time to turn in, there is a guest bedroom with a king bed and private bathroom on the first floor.On the second level, discover a primary bedroom with a king bed, private bathroom, and screened-in porch with a swing. For additional sleeping accommodations, there is a guest bedroom with a queen bed and a connected bunk area equipped with 2 twin-over-twin bunk beds—an excellent option for guests with kids.Let Salt & Sol’s private pool and stellar location backdrop a perfect Seagrove Beach vacation. There’s parking for 3 vehicles in the driveway, but guests can explore on 2 wheels with the 4 complimentary adult bikes. An inflatable paddle board is in the garage for guests looking to have some an on-the-water adventure! To locate the nearest beach access, head south on Dalton Drive. Upon reaching Eastern Lake Road, turn left and continue until the road begins to curve. The beach access is located between 471 and 493 Eastern Lake Road. Book this Florida getaway today!SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS: (SLEEPS 10):FIRST FLOOR:- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower OnlySECOND FLOOR:- Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower and Tub Separate- Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed, Shared Bathroom with Shower Only- Bunk Area: Two Twin-over-Twin Bunk Beds, Shared Bathroom with Shower Only*Garage use is for storage only. No vehicles allowed.**Please note that in order to utilize the Low-Speed Vehicle that comes with the home, you will be required to pay a $30 non-refundable deposit to 30a Gulf Carts.
